```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| title: "Open epics"
md`${state.epics.length === 0
  ? "No open epics."
  : state.epics.map(e => `- **\`${e.id}\`** — ${e.title} · ${e.counts.done}/${e.counts.total} done · ${e.counts.active} active · ${e.counts.open} open`).join("\n")}`
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| title: "Awaiting sign-off"
md`${state.freshness.awaiting_sign_off.length === 0
  ? "Nothing awaiting sign-off."
  : "Decisions still **Proposed**: " + state.freshness.awaiting_sign_off.map(id => "`" + id + "`").join(", ") + " — these are the easiest thing to lose across a gap."}

Built at commit \`${(state.built_at_commit ?? "unknown").slice(0, 8)}\`.`
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

Inputs.table(

  ),
  { rows: 40, layout: "auto" }
)
```

# Since last visit

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
diffPresent = diff.entities !== undefined
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
diffTotals = diffPresent
  ? ({
      status: diff.entities.status_changed.length,
      added: diff.entities.added.length,
      removed: diff.entities.removed.length,
      edgesAdded: diff.edges.added.length,
      edgesRemoved: diff.edges.removed.length,
      total:
        diff.entities.status_changed.length +
        diff.entities.added.length +
        diff.entities.removed.length +
        diff.edges.added.length +
        diff.edges.removed.length
    })
  : null
```

## Row {height="20%"}

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| title: "What changed"
!diffPresent
  ? md`No prior \`docs/STATE.md\` commit to anchor on — this is the first heartbeat, so there is no “last visit” to diff against.`
  : diffTotals.total === 0
    ? md`**Nothing since the last heartbeat** (\`${diff.from.commit.slice(0,8)}\` → \`${diff.to.commit.slice(0,8)}\`). Any work in progress is in the uncommitted working tree, not here.`
    : md`From \`${diff.from.commit.slice(0,8)}\` → \`${diff.to.commit.slice(0,8)}\`: **${diffTotals.status}** status move(s), **${diffTotals.added}** new / **${diffTotals.removed}** removed entit(y/ies), **${diffTotals.edgesAdded}** / **${diffTotals.edgesRemoved}** edge(s) added / removed.`
```

## Row {height="80%"}

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| title: "Status moves"
!diffPresent || diff.entities.status_changed.length === 0
  ? md`_none_`
  : Inputs.table(
      diff.entities.status_changed.map(s => ({ id: s.id, from: s.from, to: s.to })),
      { rows: 30 }
    )
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| title: "Arrivals & departures"
!diffPresent || (diff.entities.added.length === 0 && diff.entities.removed.length === 0)
  ? md`_no entities added or removed_`
  : Inputs.table(
      [
        ...diff.entities.added.map(e => ({ change: "+ new", id: e.id, kind: e.kind, title: e.title })),
        ...diff.entities.removed.map(e => ({ change: "− gone", id: e.id, kind: e.kind, title: e.title }))
      ],
      { rows: 30 }
    )
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| title: "Edges moved"
!diffPresent || (diff.edges.added.length === 0 && diff.edges.removed.length === 0)
  ? md`_no edges added or removed_`
  : md`${[
      ...diff.edges.added.map(e => "\`+ " + e + "\`"),
      ...diff.edges.removed.map(e => "\`− " + e + "\`")
    ].join("\n\n")}`
```

# Coverage

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
coverageRows = coverage.measured.map(m => {
  const row = { subject: m.id };
  for (const s of coverage.suites) row[s] = m.counts[s] ?? 0;
  row.total = m.total;
  return row;
})
```

## Row {height="55%"}

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| title: "Measured — subject × suite (case counts)"
coverageRows.length === 0
  ? md`No measured subjects yet.`
  : Inputs.table(coverageRows, { rows: 40, layout: "auto" })
```

## Row {height="45%"}

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| title: "Unmeasured — the honest complement"
coverage.unmeasured.length === 0
  ? md`Every agent and skill has at least one eval case naming it.`
  : Inputs.table(
      coverage.unmeasured.map(u => ({
        id: u.id,
        kind: u.kind,
        reason: u.reason ?? "— no stated reason (add one to evals/coverage-exceptions.md) —"
      })),
      { rows: 40, layout: "auto" }
    )
```

# Bench

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| title: "Bench state"
md`Latest committed run: \`${state.bench.latest_run ?? "none"}\` — **${runs.length}** record(s) across **${state.bench.suites.length}** suite(s). This is the only committed run set, so the marks below are a baseline read of points, not yet a trend; each new run adds a column in time.`
```

## Row {height="30%"}

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| title: "Per suite — pass rate & cost"
Inputs.table(
  state.bench.suites.map(s => ({
    suite: s.suite,
    runs: s.runs,
    pass: s.pass,
    fail: s.fail,
    pass_rate: s.runs ? (100 * s.pass / s.runs).toFixed(0) + "%" : "—",
    cost_usd: "$" + s.cost_usd.toFixed(3)
  })),
  { layout: "auto" }
)
```

## Row {height="70%"}

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| title: "Pass rate by suite"
state.bench.suites.length === 0
  ? md`No runs.`
  : Plot.plot({
      height: 300,
      marginLeft: 55,
      x: { label: "suite" },
      y: { label: "pass rate", domain: [0, 1], percent: true, grid: true },
      color: { legend: false },
      marks: [
        Plot.barY(state.bench.suites, { x: "suite", y: d => d.runs ? d.pass / d.runs : 0, fill: "suite" }),
        Plot.ruleY([0])
      ]
    })
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| title: "Cost per case over run time (faceted by model)"
runs.length === 0
  ? md`No run records.`
  : Plot.plot({
      height: 320,
      marginLeft: 55,
      x: { label: "run time", type: "utc", grid: true },
      y: { label: "cost (USD)", grid: true, zero: true },
      color: { legend: true },
      fy: { label: "model" },
      marks: [
        Plot.dot(runs, {
          x: d => new Date(d.started_at),
          y: "cost_usd",
          stroke: "suite",
          fy: "model",
          r: 4,
          tip: true
        })
      ]
    })
```
